description: This file contains a Java class `SequenceUtil` which provides utility methods for managing and generating unique sequence IDs based on named sequence banks. It interacts with a database for sequence storage and supports concurrency control, chunked sequence ID allocation, and refresh operations.

classes.name: SequenceUtil
classes.description: A utility class for managing named sequence banks, generating unique sequence IDs, and handling concurrent access to sequence records stored in a database.

methods.name: SequenceUtil
methods.description: Constructor initializing the SequenceUtil with helper info, sequence entity model, and field names.

methods.name: getNextSeqId
methods.description: Fetches the next sequence ID for a given sequence name, with optional staggering.

methods.name: forceBankRefresh
methods.description: Forces a refresh of the sequence bank for a given sequence name.

methods.name: getBank
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a SequenceBank for a specific sequence name and model entity.
